summary: Turns a one-line request into a complete ticket: every section, testable criteria, the open questions, and no invented dates, amounts or limits (#433).
request: Create a ticket to let people export their tasks as a CSV file from the Tasks page.

args.title: Export tasks as a CSV file
args.summary: Let people download their tasks as a CSV file from the Tasks page, so they can use them in a spreadsheet.
background: The person asked for a CSV export on the Tasks page.
acceptanceCriteria: The Tasks page has an Export button that downloads a CSV file of the tasks it shows
The file has a column for each of the task's title, status, priority, due date and project
A unit test checks the file's columns, and an e2e test downloads it
outOfScope: Importing tasks from a CSV file
openQuestions: Should done tasks and subtasks be in the file too?
Should the export follow the page's filters?

reference.text: Here's the ticket I'd add: Export tasks as a CSV file. Review it below, open the draft to change anything, and apply it when it looks right.

sections.title: Steps to reproduce
items: Find the day the event is on

sections.title: Expected result

sections.title: Actual result
